title: Re-assess the audit controls in the ledger and re-run probe-sdlc to confirm the gap is closed
description: Once Tasks 3-5 are complete, have soc-ledger-keeper append an observation against sebi-cscrf-2024:Sec-4.4 and cert-in-directions-2022:CCSAPG-13.1.2. The observation (methods document-review) cites the Task 1-5 evidence, then the two control records are superseded with the implementationStatus and effectiveness that evidence supports. Then run /probe-sdlc example-co. Under the soc-ledger absence rule, fnd_01M2GS6B87TV7NHZQ8BMGDR4HZ (fingerprint 89d9c73d7be083df67baa72a3c954772a8645f51a31124b26b2cdaeebf33c55f, ruleId ssdf-rv-2-2-no-audit-remediation-loop) resolves only after two distinct runs do not produce it. Schedule the second run before the finding's slaDueAt of 2026-12-13T19:35:56Z.
acceptanceCriteria: The latest-state ledger records for sebi-cscrf-2024:Sec-4.4 and cert-in-directions-2022:CCSAPG-13.1.2 no longer show implementationStatus unknown / effectiveness not-tested, and each has evidence[] pointing to the Task 1-5 artefacts.
The probe-sdlc SARIF export for the run shows no result with ruleId ssdf-rv-2-2-no-audit-remediation-loop for target company:example-co.

verificationMethod.description: Run /probe-sdlc example-co twice as distinct runs after Tasks 3-5 are done. Expected result: neither run produces fingerprint 89d9c73d7be083df67baa72a3c954772a8645f51a31124b26b2cdaeebf33c55f; the observation for sebi-cscrf-2024:Sec-4.4 has result satisfied or partial; and refresh-soc supersedes fnd_01M2GS6B87TV7NHZQ8BMGDR4HZ with status resolved.

rootCause.description: Control records for the audit obligations were created from the catalog and never re-assessed against real audit evidence, so the ledger could not show whether the audit loop exists.
